text:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing the launch acceptance buckets for Smart Routing (prod entry). I sketched an owner matrix and minimal SLA/docs/support requirements. Need yes/no + any blockers by EOD.

sam: skimmed the matrix, looks reasonable. two quick q: is p99 latency target for hosted per-tenant or global?

liam: @sam global for measurements, but we can expose per-tenant radar in Console later. For GA we must guarantee global p99 and a per-tenant SLA note.

anika: I'll own docs for the public runbook and the internal oncall play. Need the exact error codes and fallback behavior. Can someone paste the fallback decision tree?

maria: fallback rules are in the spec PR (link in thread). short version: 1) route to smaller model variant, 2) retry with shorter prompt (client-side hint), 3) circuit-break to 503 with user-facing message after 2nd failure.

jordan: support ask: we need a short FAQ and an escalation matrix. Who owns after-hours for the first 30 days?

sam: eng-oncall will cover first 2 weeks, then rotate to product-oncall with SRE backup. Need to document the exact paging thresholds.

liam: paging thresholds proposal: CPU/GPU saturation >90% for 5m, p99 latency >2x target for 3m, error-rate >1% for 5m. those go to eng-oncall first.

oliver: pricing check — sales requests a pilot discount and a mid-tier SLA for pilot customers. Are we ok adding a "pilot" pricing SKU with limited commitments?

maria: tentative yes, but pilot SKU must be clearly non-SLA'd (no uptime credit) and timeboxed. Pricing PM to draft terms. @oliver can you capture pricing language?

anika: docs action: I need the final SLA bullets (what we promise and what we don't) by tomorrow noon. If wording isn't final I will add placeholders but mark as DRAFT.

sam: infra readiness: autoscale policies tested in staging with 3x synthetic load, KV cache warmup validated. We still need canary in prod traffic mirror for 48h before GA.

maria: decision needed: do we require 48h canary mirror before flipping GA? vote: thumbs-up = yes.

liam: +1 :thumbsup:

sam: +1

jordan: +1

oliver: +1

anika: +1

maria: accepted — 48h mirror required.

maria: final acceptance checklist (minimal for GA):
- SLA: documented p99 targets + credit policy (docs owner: anika)
- Observability: synthetic tests + realtime alerting + traces (owner: liam)
- Support: FAQ + escalation matrix + 24/7 coverage plan first 2 weeks (owner: jordan)
- Docs: public runbook + internal oncall playbook + release notes (owner: anika)
- Pricing: pilot SKU language + standard SKU tiers + billing integration check (owner: oliver)
- Rollout: 48h traffic mirror canary + gradual % ramp plan (owner: sam)
- Compliance: data-routing note for private deployments + KMS mapping verified (owner: product security)

sam: I'll attach the canary runbook and ramp script to the PR.

deploy-bot: NOTE: canary mirror job scheduled for 2289998000 UTC (automated).

maria: next steps: owners, please drop any missing artifacts into the launch folder by EOD tomorrow. if anything is blocking your work, flag it here now.

jordan: I'll draft the escalation matrix and start a short training doc for support ops.

anika: placeholder for SLA bullets added. will iterate.

sam: blocker: need SA access to billing test account to validate pilot SKU invoicing. @finance?

oliver: looping in finance offline.

maria: thanks all. we'll reconvene tomorrow 10am to confirm green on each checklist item. If any owner can't meet their deadline, call it out here.

liam: noted — I'll ship synthetic test results tonight.

maria: great, closing thread for now. keep updates as replies here. :rocket:
